name: bjj-tracker
description: Multi-sport progression tracker (BJJ, Judo, Boxing, CrossFit) with video demonstrations and competition rules

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html styles.css data.js data-judo.js data-boxing.js data-crossfit.js data-weightlifting.js videos.js app.js meals.js manifest.webmanifest sw.js icon-*.png purelab-logo.png bg-rolling.jpg www/
scripts.ios:init: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
